stay quiet about people who'd do
something that awful.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Thank you. I believe the fighting spirit within all of you will surely defeat this evil.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you. I believe the fighting spirit
in all of you will surely defeat this evil.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: But hey... we're technically civilians. What's the military even doing, relying on us for this?
rows.display_text:
「But hey... we're technically civilians.
What's the military doing, relying on us
for this?」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: I hear you, Kappei... but while the Spacetime Restoration stabilized the world, unrest is still ongoing within each nation.
rows.display_text:
「I hear you, Kappei... but while the
Restoration stabilized the world, unrest
continues within each nation.」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: That's why the strength of people like us, who aren't bound by national borders, is needed.
rows.display_text:
「That's why the strength of people like
us, unbound by national borders, is
needed.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: In other words, they judged that reforming $c was the best option.
rows.display_text:
「In other words, they judged that
reforming $c was the best option.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: So now we're basically an independent unit, sanctioned by the whole world?
rows.display_text:
「So now we're basically an independent
unit, sanctioned by the whole world?」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: Right up until the Spacetime Restoration, we were treated as terrorists working in the shadows. Quite the turnaround.
rows.display_text:
「Right up until the Spacetime
Restoration, we were treated as shadowy
terrorists. Quite the turnaround.」

rows.speaker: Kiraken
rows.en: That's all thanks to everyone coming to understand us.
rows.display_text:
「That's all thanks to everyone coming to
understand us.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Gotta work hard to live up to those expectations, then.
rows.display_text:
「Gotta work hard to live up to those
expectations, then.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: But we still don't know anything about the enemy that attacked all over the world, right?
rows.display_text:
「But we still know nothing about the
enemy that attacked all over the world,
right?」

rows.speaker: Mizuki
rows.en: First, we need to organize what information we currently have on the enemy.
rows.display_text:
「First, we need to organize what
information we currently have on the
enemy.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: On that front, the New Earth Federation has sent over some materials. Let me explain them to everyone.
rows.display_text:
「The New Earth Federation has sent over
some materials on that. Let me explain to
everyone.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Rie, Eina... I'll need your help.
rows.display_text: 「Rie, Eina... I'll need your help.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: Understood, Sandman.
rows.display_text: 「Understood, Sandman.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: First, on the extent of the damage worldwide--we haven't been able to pin down exact numbers yet.
rows.display_text:
「First, on worldwide damage--we haven't
pinned down exact numbers yet.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: But apparently the attacks were mainly aimed at destroying facilities, and human casualties have been extremely minimal.
rows.display_text:
「But the attacks apparently targeted
facilities mainly, and human casualties
have been extremely minimal.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Even with attacks that intense!?
rows.display_text: 「Even with attacks that intense!?」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: So it was a show of force, then.
rows.display_text: 「So it was a show of force, then.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: That seems highly likely. It was probably a demonstration meant to show off their own power.
rows.display_text:
「That seems likely. Probably a
demonstration meant to show off their
own power.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Put another way, this city was probably devastated this thoroughly precisely because it was uninhabited.
rows.display_text:
「Put another way, this city was probably
devastated this thoroughly because it was
uninhabited.」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: And the unmanned units' attacks have been confirmed across the entire atmosphere.
rows.display_text:
「And the unmanned units' attacks have
been confirmed across the entire
atmosphere.」

rows.speaker: Raita
rows.en: Moving units all across the entire world--just how much organizational power does that take...!
rows.display_text:
「Moving units across the entire
world--how much organizational power does
that take...!」

rows.speaker: Oliver
rows.en: That alone suggests the enemy's scale is something to be feared.
rows.display_text:
「That alone suggests the enemy's scale
is something to be feared.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: However, there's information that overturns that hypothesis.
rows.display_text:
「However, there's information that
overturns that hypothesis.」

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.display_text: 「What do you mean?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: First, take a look at this map. It marks the regions that were damaged in this attack.
rows.display_text:
「First, take a look at this map, marking
the regions damaged in this attack.」

rows.speaker: Rag
rows.en: That's awful. The whole world really has been attacked.
rows.display_text:
「That's awful. The whole world really
has been attacked.」

rows.speaker: Faye
rows.en: But it's strange. There's no strategic intent visible in where the attacks hit.
rows.display_text:
「But it's strange. There's no strategic
intent visible in where the attacks hit.」

rows.speaker: Eina
rows.en: There are even cases where cities and military facilities were ignored while small settlements were attacked.
rows.display_text:
「There are even cases where cities and
military facilities were ignored while small
settlements were attacked.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: So it really was an indiscriminate attack...?
rows.display_text:
「So it really was an indiscriminate
attack...?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: No... there's a hidden pattern to the attacks.
rows.display_text:
「No... there's a hidden pattern to the
attacks.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Let's overlay this map with the locations of something the New Earth Federation was investigating during the war.
rows.display_text:
「Let's overlay this map with the
locations of something the New Earth
Federation investigated during the war.」

rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: They almost line up completely...!
rows.display_text: 「They almost line up completely...!」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Just what was it the military was investigating?
rows.display_text:
「Just what was it the military was
investigating?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Something called the Mountain Cycle.
rows.display_text: 「Something called the Mountain Cycle.」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: I heard about it from Loran once. That's the ruin where treasures of the Black History sleep, right?
rows.display_text:
「I heard about it from Loran once.
That's the ruin where Black History
treasures sleep, right?」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: That's right. But it seems what's sleeping there isn't exactly treasure.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. But it seems what's
sleeping there isn't exactly treasure.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: No way...! Those unmanned units...
rows.display_text: 「No way...! Those unmanned units...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Just as you suspected, Gainer.
rows.display_text: 「Just as you suspected, Gainer.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Putting together the few eyewitness reports we have, it seems the unmanned units emerged from a Mountain Cycle and attacked the surrounding area.
rows.display_text:
「A few eyewitness reports suggest the
units emerged from a Mountain Cycle and
attacked nearby.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: Then the mystery enemy is...
rows.display_text: 「Then the mystery enemy is...」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: A relic of the Black History...!?
rows.display_text: 「A relic of the Black History...!?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (Could King Gainer's rampage be connected to this too...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Could King Gainer's rampage be
connected to this too...?)）

rows.speaker: Marin
rows.en: But this explains the reckless strategy of deploying units all over the world.
rows.display_text:
「But this explains the reckless strategy
of deploying units all over the world.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: So the unmanned units weren't dispatched--they were already there from the start.
rows.display_text:
「So the unmanned units weren't
dispatched--they were already there from
the start.」

rows.speaker: Birin
rows.en: So those things had been sleeping underground ever since the Black History era...
rows.display_text:
「So those things had been sleeping
underground ever since the Black History
era...」

rows.speaker: Birin
rows.en: And they only just recently woke up and started attacking...!?
rows.display_text:
「And they only just recently woke up
and started attacking...!?」

rows.speaker: Hayato
rows.en: You're saying that happened simultaneously all over the world? That's way too unnatural...
rows.display_text:
「You're saying that happened
simultaneously worldwide? Way too
unnatural...」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: If they're unmanned, that means they've got an autopilot system built in, right?
rows.display_text:
「If unmanned, that means they've got an
autopilot system built in, right?」

rows.speaker: Benkei
rows.en: So then wouldn't that mean someone gave them the order to attack?
rows.display_text:
「So then wouldn't that mean someone
gave them the order to attack?」

rows.speaker: Michiru
rows.en: True, that would explain why the attacks happened worldwide at the same time, but...
rows.display_text:
「True, that would explain why the
attacks happened worldwide at once, but...」

rows.speaker: Tekkouki
rows.en: But to pull that off, someone would need to know these unmanned units existed and issue an activation order to the entire world at once.
rows.display_text:
「But to pull this off, someone must
know these units existed and order
worldwide activation at once.」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: Someone who knows of the Black History's legacy and commands its power, huh...
rows.display_text:
「Someone who knows of the Black
History's legacy and commands its power,
huh...」

rows.speaker: Tekkouki
rows.en: Conversely, that means the key to tracking down the enemy lies in that unmanned unit's control system.
rows.display_text:
「Conversely, the key to tracking the
enemy lies in that unmanned unit's control
system.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Exactly right. On that front, the wreckage of a unit shot down in the previous attack has been examined.
rows.display_text:
「Exactly right. On that front, wreckage
of a unit downed in the previous attack
has been examined.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: As a result, it's been confirmed that all of the unmanned units were operating under the same control system.
rows.display_text:
「As a result, all the unmanned units
were confirmed to run under the same
control system.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: So then someone really did plan this whole thing after all...!
rows.display_text:
「So then someone really did plan this
whole thing after all...!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: But setting the activation aside, it seems the unmanned units acted completely autonomously once combat began.
rows.display_text:
「But aside from activation, the unmanned
units seem to have acted fully
autonomously once combat began.」

rows.speaker: Rie
rows.en: In other words, the attack behavior itself was most likely preset in advance.
rows.display_text:
「In other words, the attack behavior
itself was most likely preset in advance.」

rows.speaker: Jun
rows.en: Then are you saying this attack was prepared all the way back in the Black History era?
rows.display_text:
「So you're saying this attack was
prepared all the way back in the Black
History era?」

rows.speaker: Raven
rows.en: That's the only conclusion we can draw.
rows.display_text: 「That's the only conclusion we can draw.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: What the hell is that...
rows.display_text: 「What the hell is that...」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: Who the hell was it!? Burying something that dangerous in the ground...!
rows.display_text:
「Who the hell was it!? Burying something
that dangerous in the ground...!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: ...While analyzing the autopilot mechanism, a certain term kept appearing frequently.
rows.display_text:
「...Analyzing the autopilot mechanism, a
certain term kept appearing frequently.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Executor... That appears to be the name of the system controlling the unmanned units.
rows.display_text:
「Executor... That's the apparent name of
the system controlling the unmanned units.」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: The Executor... System.
rows.display_text: 「The Executor... System.」

rows.speaker: Julie
rows.en: 'Executor,' huh... Quite the grandiose name.
rows.display_text:
「'Executor,' huh... Quite the grandiose
name.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (Is that system installed in King Gainer too...?)
rows.display_text:
（(Is that system installed in King
Gainer too...?)）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (No... that's not it. King Gainer was being called by something... I don't know what, but...)
rows.display_text:
（(No... that's not it. King Gainer was
called by something... I don't know what,
but...)）

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Gainer... are you worried about that rampage from before?
rows.display_text:
「Gainer... are you worried about that
rampage from before?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Sorry for worrying you, Cynthia. But I still don't think this and that are unrelated.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry for worrying you, Cynthia. But I
still don't think this and that are
unrelated.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: ...Still, it's hard to wrap my head around. Are you saying people from the Black History era prepared this to attack people of a later age...?
rows.display_text:
「Hard to grasp, but you're saying Black
History people prepared this to attack
later generations...?」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Those unmanned units are machines from organizations we've fought before.
rows.display_text:
「Those unmanned units are machines from
organizations we've fought before.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Seeing that really drives home that a $c different from ours was what caused the Black History.
rows.display_text:
「Seeing that drives home that a $c
different from ours caused the Black
History.」

rows.speaker: Blume
rows.en: But what are we gonna do? The Moon's D.O.M.E. doesn't even work anymore, does it?
rows.display_text:
「But what do we do? The Moon's D.O.M.E.
doesn't even work anymore, does it?」

rows.speaker: Dike
rows.en: Even if we want to learn about the Black History, is there really no way left to investigate it...
rows.display_text:
「Even wanting to learn about the Black
History, is there no way left to
investigate it...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: On that front, I have an idea. If you'll give me a little more time, I should have results.
rows.display_text:
「On that, I have an idea. Give me a
little more time and I should have
results.」

rows.speaker: Jiron
rows.en: If you say so, I'll leave it to you. We'll be counting on you.
rows.display_text:
「If you say so, I'll leave it to you.
We'll be counting on you.」

rows.speaker: Athena
rows.en: But with neither the enemy's identity nor their goal known, are we stuck reacting to them...?
rows.display_text:
「With neither the enemy's identity nor
goal known, are we stuck reacting to
them...?」

rows.speaker: Orson
rows.en: For now, all we can do is what we can. Let's move too, to limit the damage as much as possible.
rows.display_text:
「For now, we do what we can. Let's move
too, to limit the damage as much as
possible.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: It's the same situation for the North Ameria unit. For the time being, we'll trace the enemy's movements and intercept them if they attack again.
rows.display_text:
「Same for North Ameria. For now we'll
track the enemy and intercept if they
strike again.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: Even the invincible $c is at a loss when it comes to this, huh...
rows.display_text:
「Even the invincible $c is at a loss
when it comes to this, huh...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Sorry we're late. Gekkostate has arrived.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry we're late. Gekkostate has
arrived.」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Sorry, Holland. I know I asked you to gather everyone.
rows.display_text:
「Sorry, Holland. I know I asked you to
gather everyone.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: You don't need to worry about that. I understand how serious this is too.
rows.display_text:
「You don't need to worry about that. I
understand how serious this is too.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: In a world this dangerous, neither Talho nor the kid in her belly can settle down.
rows.display_text:
「In a world this dangerous, neither Talho
nor our unborn kid can settle down.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Sounds like you're finally growing into being a father.
rows.display_text:
「Sounds like you're finally growing into
being a father.」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: If Papa stays a drifter forever, our sweet baby's going to have a hard time, you know.
rows.display_text:
「If Papa stays a drifter forever, our
baby's going to have a hard time, you
know.」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: You're not showing yet...
rows.display_text: 「You're not showing yet...」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Same to you, Mimsy. Looks like we've both got a lot of trouble ahead.
rows.display_text:
「Same to you, Mimsy. Looks like we've
both got a lot of trouble ahead.」

rows.speaker: Mimsy
rows.en: It's this kind of world, after all. And more than that, look at the men we each chose.
rows.display_text:
「It's this kind of world. And more than
that, look at the men we each chose.」

rows.speaker: Kei
rows.en: That's what she says, Mr. Charisma of the Youth.
rows.display_text:
「That's what she says, Mr. Charisma of
the Youth.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Eh... let 'em say whatever they want. Woman may be weak, but a mother is strong.
rows.display_text:
「Eh... let 'em talk. Woman may be weak,
but a mother is strong.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Well, well... thanks for the lecture.
rows.display_text: 「Well, well... thanks for the lecture.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's a bit over my head, Gain.
rows.display_text: 「That's a bit over my head, Gain.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: There they are, the drunkard duo!
rows.display_text: 「There they are, the drunkard duo!」

rows.speaker: Yassaba
rows.en: I'm here too, Adette.
rows.display_text: 「I'm here too, Adette.」

rows.speaker: Gauli
rows.en: You came, Yassaba Jin. I appreciate your help.
rows.display_text:
「You came, Yassaba Jin. I appreciate
your help.」

rows.speaker: Yassaba
rows.en: Don't be so distant with me. I couldn't call myself a man if I stayed quiet while villains ran wild all over the world.
rows.display_text:
「Don't be so distant. I couldn't call
myself a man if I stayed quiet while
villains ran wild worldwide.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That some folks don't like peace, well... it's not like I can't understand it. Villains never really go extinct.
rows.display_text:
「That some folks dislike peace, well...
it's not like I can't understand it.
Villains never really go extinct.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: But I don't like the way this bunch operates. Can't even sleep easy.
rows.display_text:
「But I don't like the way this bunch
operates. Can't even sleep easy.」

rows.speaker: Sara
rows.en: I'm grateful for the help, but you're still going to apologize properly for leaving without even saying goodbye.
rows.display_text:
「I'm grateful for the help, but you're
still apologizing properly for leaving
without even saying goodbye.」

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: Don't say that. Holland practically begged, so I came running here, shame be damned.
rows.display_text:
「Don't say that. Holland practically
begged, so I ran here, shame be damned.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: That's right. Besides, the reason there was no goodbye is 'cause I didn't want anyone seeing my tears at parting.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. Besides, there was no
goodbye 'cause I didn't want anyone
seeing my tears at parting.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Unbelievable...! What mouth is 'tears' even coming out of?
rows.display_text:
「Unbelievable...! What mouth is 'tears'
even coming out of?」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: This mouth, right here...!
rows.display_text: 「This mouth, right here...!」

rows.speaker: Maria
rows.en: There it is, the Heat Smile!
rows.display_text: 「There it is, the Heat Smile!」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Don't talk about Darling's smile like it's a cockroach!
rows.display_text:
「Don't talk about Darling's smile like
it's a cockroach!」

rows.speaker: Chill
rows.en: It's Big Sis Mel!
rows.display_text: 「It's Big Sis Mel!」

rows.en: I was worried. When you went missing in all the chaos of the Spacetime Restoration.
rows.display_text:
「I was worried. When you went missing in
all the chaos of the Spacetime
Restoration.」

rows.speaker: Leele
rows.en: But I'm glad. That we got to see each other again like this.

「But I'm glad. That we got to see each
other again like this.」

rows.speaker: Mel

「Thanks, everyone! Mel Beater's doing

rows.speaker: Cynthia
rows.en: Huh? Wasn't your hair supposed to have grown out?
rows.display_text:
「Huh? Wasn't your hair supposed to have

rows.speaker: Mel

「It was a pain, so I cut it. Long hair's
a hassle, and it gets in the way of
repair work too.」

rows.speaker: Matthieu
rows.en: Speaking of which, Repairman... didn't you say you'd marry Mel once her hair grew out...?
rows.display_text:
「Speaking of which, Repairman... didn't
you say you'd marry Mel once her hair

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Now's not the time to be talking about that!

「Now's not the time to be talking about

rows.speaker: Hilda
rows.en: Don't just shout out of nowhere...!
rows.display_text: 「Don't just shout out of nowhere...!」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: Well... he's got a point, but...
rows.display_text: 「Well... he's got a point, but...」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: The world's in serious trouble because of this mystery enemy. We gathered here to fight them... don't forget that.
rows.display_text:
「The world's in serious trouble from this
mystery enemy. We gathered to fight
them... don't forget that.」

rows.speaker: Moondoggie
rows.en: Y-yeah.
rows.display_text: 「Y-yeah.」

rows.speaker: Adette
rows.en: Is that okay, Mel? Darling just brushed it off with momentum there.
rows.display_text:
「Is that okay, Mel? Darling just brushed
it off with momentum there.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Don't worry about it, don't worry about it. I still want to enjoy my single days a while longer.

「Don't worry about it. I still want to
enjoy my single days a while longer.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Besides, seeing Darling react like that is pretty fun to watch.

「Besides, seeing Darling react like that

rows.speaker: Gain

「Sheesh... seeing him like this, even The

「More importantly, Gain... Gainer's been

rows.en: Are you still mad that I didn't say goodbye?

「Are you still mad that I didn't say

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: ...It's not that. I figured that as long as we were both alive, we'd meet again somewhere sometime...
rows.display_text:
「...It's not that. I figured as long as

rows.en: That's a positive way to think. So what's a guy like that got on his mind?
rows.display_text:
「That's a positive way to think. So

rows.speaker: Gainer

rows.en: Go ahead and talk. But this is gonna square us on that whole goodbye thing.

「Go ahead and talk. But this is gonna

「Has anything seemed off with

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Like suddenly not responding to controls, or moving on its own...

「Like suddenly not responding to

rows.speaker: Gain
rows.en: No... nothing like that in particular.

（(Before, King Gainer and Emperanza
both stirred up the fighting spirit of us
pilots...)）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (I thought this rampage might be something similar, but there's nothing unusual with Emperanza.)
rows.display_text:
（(I thought this rampage might be
similar, but nothing's unusual with
Emperanza.)）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: (Is King Gainer just special, then...?)
rows.display_text: （(Is King Gainer just special, then...?)）

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: ...Are you okay, Big Bro Gainer?
rows.display_text: 「...Are you okay, Big Bro Gainer?」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Renton...! Why are you here!?
rows.display_text: 「Renton...! Why are you here!?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: It's not just me. Eureka's here too.
rows.display_text: 「It's not just me. Eureka's here too.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: But didn't Nirvash go off to the other side of dimensions during the Spacetime Restoration?
rows.display_text:
「But didn't Nirvash go to the other side
of dimensions during the Restoration?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Even without Nirvash, I'm still a member of Gekkostate. I'll fight alongside everyone.
rows.display_text:
「Even without Nirvash, I'm still a member
of Gekkostate. I'll fight alongside
everyone.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: What do you mean, member of Gekkostate. You forced your way into contacting us and muscled your way aboard.
rows.display_text:
「What do you mean, member of
Gekkostate. You forced contact with us,
then forced your way aboard.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: But I wanted to be useful to everyone too, even just a little...
rows.display_text:
「But I wanted to be useful to everyone
too, even just a little...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: You don't have to say it, I already know. That's why I approved you and Eureka joining.
rows.display_text:
「You don't have to say it, I know.
That's why I approved you and Eureka
joining.」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Thank you, Holland. I... feel the same way as Renton.
rows.display_text:
「Thank you, Holland. I... feel the same
way as Renton.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Given the situation, you two are gonna fight as crew of the Gekko-Goh.
rows.display_text:
「Given the situation, you two are gonna
fight as crew of the Gekko-Goh.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Understood!
rows.display_text: 「Understood!」

rows.speaker: Bello
rows.en: By the way, Renton... what happened to that image change you had before the Spacetime Restoration?
rows.display_text:
「By the way, Renton... what happened to
that image change from before the
Restoration?」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: That was just for a special occasion. Normally, I'll stick with being myself, no putting on airs, same as always.
rows.display_text:
「That was just for a special occasion.
Normally I'll be myself, no airs, same as
always.」

rows.speaker: Hanae
rows.en: It's urgent, Grandpa! An unidentified unit is approaching us!
rows.display_text:
「It's urgent, Grandpa! An unidentified
unit is approaching us!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: What did you say...!
rows.display_text: 「What did you say...!」

rows.speaker: Umee
rows.en: There's a lot of them too. This has gotta be those unmanned units.
rows.display_text:
「There's a lot of them too. This has
gotta be those unmanned units.」

rows.speaker: Kappei
rows.en: If they're coming to us, all the better! Let's beat them senseless!
rows.display_text:
「If they're coming to us, all the better!
Let's beat them senseless!」

rows.speaker: Daisuke
rows.en: If we confront them directly, we might be able to grab some kind of clue...!
rows.display_text:
「If we confront them directly, we might
be able to grab some kind of clue...!」

rows.speaker: Toshiya
rows.en: These are the guys who trashed the world however they pleased. Time they paid up for it!
rows.display_text:
「These are the guys who trashed the
world as they pleased. Time they paid up
for it!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Hell yeah! I'm getting fired up for the first time in a while!
rows.display_text:
「Hell yeah! I'm getting fired up for the
first time in a while!」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Everyone of $c, the time to launch has come!
rows.display_text:
「Everyone of $c, the time to launch
has come!」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: From here, we will intercept the mystery enemy and expose their true identity...!
rows.display_text:
「From here, we intercept the mystery
enemy and expose their true identity...!」
